decisions.approved: score >= 85, no high/critical findings, product type correct
decisions.needs_revision: 60 <= score < 85 or medium findings, no critical findings
decisions.human_review_required: high finding with low confidence, visual uncertainty, or rule conflict
decisions.rejected: score < 60, critical finding, wrong product type, severe identity loss or hallucination
decisions.blocked: generation blocked, missing output, or unusable file
